news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
news.summary: Researchers have mapped out private bitcoin-denominated transfers that run alongside Bitcoin, but the system still lacks a finished way to lock up real BTC and release it again.

news.title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2
news.summary: Peirce, known as “Crypto Mom,” served on the SEC for about eight years, including as director of the Crypto Task Force.

news.title: CFTC sues Cash FX, alleges $950M crypto-linked forex scheme
news.summary: The CFTC claimed that Cash FX engaged in minimal forex trading and misappropriated most of the participant funds.

news.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
news.summary: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.

news.title: XRP Ledger’s Batch upgrade slips to Oct. 9 after validator support resets
news.summary: The feature would let users bundle up to eight transactions, including asset-and-payment transfers, but a brief drop below the network’s 80% support threshold restarted its two-week activation clock.

news.title: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
news.summary: The long-anticipated exit of the commissioner sometimes known as Crypto Mom is Oct. 2, announced as the agency was sending out its latest crypto work.

news.title: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
news.summary: A Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled that prediction markets' sports-related events contracts are not swaps, and therefore aren't subject to federal regulatory oversight.

news.title: OG.com seeks CFTC approval for single-stock perpetual futures
news.summary: OG.com, recently spun out of Crypto.com, joins Coinbase, Kalshi and Kraken parent Payward in seeking approval to bring perpetual futures to individual US stocks.

news.title: SEC crypto FAQ addresses token buybacks, network upgrades and promises of profit
news.summary: Promoting a network’s current uses generally would not create an expectation of profit, SEC staff said.

news.title: Ex-CFTC leader to leave Blockchain Association after CLARITY vote fails
news.summary: Former CFTC Commissioner Summer Mersinger joined the Blockchain Association in 2025 after resigning during her second term at the federal commodities regulator.

news.title: Blockchain Association sees leadership shift shortly after crypto Clarity Act fizzles
news.summary: The trade group will be run again by its original CEO, Kristin Smith, when Summer Mersinger leaves at the end of a long congressional tussle.

news.title: Blockchain Association CEO Summer Mersinger to step down, Kristin Smith to return as interim CEO
news.summary: The Blockchain Association is switching up its leadership with CEO Summer Mersinger set to step down next month.

news.title: Tether says it had ‘limited’ exposure to bank linked to $84M US seizure
news.summary: US prosecutors alleged that a payments business illegally transferred hundreds of millions of dollars at the direction of EQIBank, where Tether holds some assets.

news.title: Former Hack VC partner Hsin-Ju Chuang’s death ruled a suicide
news.summary: The crypto executive and Dystopia Labs founder previously held senior roles at Stellar and Solana before joining venture capital firm Hack VC.

news.title: Man charged in $16 million crypto ‘massive pig butchering’ scam
news.summary: A man was charged for his role in defrauding someone of millions of dollars' worth of crypto in a "massive pig butchering" scam.

news.title: Bitget clarifies $388M in assets affected by security breach
news.summary: The Bitget breach announced on Thursday affected about $35 million more than previously reported, based on an analysis of assets on Zcash and TRON.

news.title: Strategy seeks shareholder approval for daily preferred stock dividends
news.summary: Strategy’s proposal would move STRC and its three other preferred stocks to daily dividend payments, following a similar move by Bitcoin treasury firm Strive.

news.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street and crypto fight for the same turf
news.summary: Stablecoins and tokenized assets are pushing banks, exchanges and crypto companies into the same markets, from payments to stocks and ETFs.

news.title: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
news.summary: The stablecoin issuer blacklisted a wallet holding about $318,000 in USDT and USDC. Most of the stolen funds sit in ether, which can't be frozen.

news.title: Tokenization is moving faster than Washington
news.summary: Regulatory clarity is not simply a legal or political issue, argues former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo. It is an economic one.

news.title: Tether confirms minimal EQIBank exposure following $89M US asset seizure
news.summary: While Tether's stated ceiling places its maximum exposure under $64 million, the incident underscores lingering counterparty risks in fiat gateway networks.

news.title: Strategy proposes daily dividends to bring STRC back toward $100
news.summary: STRC has remained below $100 since May, despite a 12% dividend rate and roughly $1 billion in preferred share buybacks.

news.title: Magic Eden legacy approvals leave $5.7 million in NFTs exposed to exploit before rescue
news.summary: Magic Eden legacy approvals exposed $5.7 million in NFTs to an exploit before whitehats rescued 23,155 tokens.

news.title: Aave V4 on Base adds Coinbase tokenized stocks as collateral for USDC loans
news.summary: Aave V4 added Apple, Nvidia, Tesla, and four more tokenized stocks as collateral for USDC loans for non-U.S. users.

news.title: Strategy proposes daily dividends for STRC, STRD, STRF and STRK preferred stocks
news.summary: Strategy is seeking shareholder approval to pay daily dividends across its four U.S.-listed preferred stocks.

news.title: Exchanges reporting crypto gains to IRS becomes tax nightmare
news.summary: The IRS can now see your crypto gains, but has no idea about the cost-basis. That’s proving to be a big headache for some cryptocurrency investors.

news.title: CoinMarketCap buys CoinGlass to expand crypto derivatives data
news.summary: CoinGlass will retain its brand and team, while its website, app, free tools, API and pricing will remain unchanged following the acquisition.

news.title: SlowMist has yet to confirm crypto theft from iPhone Safari attack
news.summary: The analyzed Safari sample targets iOS 18.4–18.6.2 using previously patched flaws, while its effectiveness on iOS 26.5 remains unverified.

news.title: Bond volatility surges while bitcoin and Wall Street stay calm
news.summary: Bond volatility is at its highest since March, while the bitcoin VIX, BVIV and Wall Street's VIX remain near its yearly low.

news.title: Bitcoin holders are cashing out, just not the way they did at prior market tops
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 25, 2026

news.title: IBIT options price trading more calmly after Bitcoin rebound
news.summary: IBIT’s expected volatility sits near the bottom of its 12-month range, according to Saxo Bank’s analysis of options data from Sept. 23.

news.title: Ethena expands USDe backing strategy into bStocks and equity perpetuals on Binance
news.summary: Ethena is adding Binance bStocks and equity perpetuals to the basis trade used for USDe's backing strategy.

news.title: Altcoins rally across the board as bitcoin consolidates near $84,000
news.summary: Quant jumped 39% over 24 hours and 93 of 100 CoinDesk 100 constituents rose, with the altcoin season index at its highest in more than three months.

news.title: Magic Eden scare puts 3,832 NFTs in whitehat protective custody
news.summary: Yuga Labs’ 0xQuit said the NFTs are safe and will be returned once the risk passes, while holders were urged to revoke NFT permissions.

news.title: Bitcoin ETF flows turn positive for 2026 after erasing $5.8 billion deficit
news.summary: At one point in July, ETFs were down $5.8 billion in net outflows for the year. Now, that’s turned into $800 million in net inflows.

news.title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero, claims it endorsed setup used in $292 million rsETH exploit
news.summary: KelpDAO sued LayerZero and Bryan Pellegrino over the April 18 rsETH exploit, alleging the bridge setup was endorsed in writing.

news.title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero for the largest exploit 2026 has seen so far
news.summary: The cross-chain lending protocol accused LayerZero and its co-founder Brian Pellegrino of failing to disclose weaknesses in their protocol, which led to the $292 million hack.

news.title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero, CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit
news.summary: KelpDAO says LayerZero endorsed its bridge setup before the attack, while CEO Bryan Pellegrino has dismissed the lawsuit as meritless.

news.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows slow to $191M as six-day streak reaches $2.8B
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $191 million Thursday as daily inflows slowed for a third day, lifting year-to-date net flows to $787 million.

news.title: Samourai Wallet co-founder faces transfer after 30-day jail ordeal
news.summary: Keonne Rodriguez says he and 70 others face another move after their treatment program was deactivated. His previous transfer took 30 days.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin moves to $84,000, oil slides on latest report of Middle East progress
news.summary: Separate reports from Axios and CBS suggest some positive movement in U.S.-Iran negotiations.

news.title: Australian PM warns of AI’s ‘furious pace’ after agent breached government site
news.summary: Anthony Albanese said governments must help shape AI’s development, after revealing earlier that an OpenAI agent accessed non-public files on an Australian Medicare data portal.

news.title: Researchers propose Zcash-style private Bitcoin transfers without a soft fork
news.summary: Shielded Bitcoin would use zero-knowledge proofs and encrypted notes to hide transaction details without changing Bitcoin consensus, but researchers have raised questions about anonymity and quantum resistance.

news.title: Bitget's $352 million hack happened via spoofed transfers, not private keys, CEO Gracy Chen says
news.summary: Bitget lost $351.6 million after attackers compromised a wallet backend, spoofed transaction data, Chen said on X.

news.title: Block brings Bitcoin Lightning payments to x402 for AI agents
news.summary: Block joins Google, Microsoft, AWS and Coinbase in backing x402, an open payment standard enabling agentic AI commerce.

news.title: Bitget CEO suspects North Korea behind $352M hack, citing IP clues
news.summary: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said a preliminary investigation found IP addresses matching VPN choices associated with a DPRK hacking group.

news.title: Asia dominates Crypto Adoption Index, Bitget’s $352M hack: Asia Express
news.summary: The APAC region accounts for half of the Global Crypto Adoption Index. Bitget suffers massive $352M loss and OpenAI forgets to mention its agents hacked the Australian Government.

news.title: New York sues Polymarket, alleging it is running an illegal gambling operation
news.summary: The state wants to block Polymarket from operating without a gambling license and recover allegedly illegal gains.

news.title: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
news.summary: The Fed proposed rules on putting last year's GENIUS Act into place with regulations, including those governing stablecoin yield programs.

news.title: Fed proposes new capital, redemption rules for stablecoin issuers
news.summary: The Fed’s proposal would set capital requirements, a two-day redemption window and new reserve disclosures as regulators implement the GENIUS Act.

news.title: Crypto exchange Bitget says $352 million affected in a hack, claims user funds are 'safe'
news.summary: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen announced the hack shortly after independent researchers flagged unusual wallet movements.

news.title: Bitget confirms $352M security breach, suspends withdrawals
news.summary: Bitget said unauthorized transfers affected a limited number of hot wallets, while cold wallets and most platform assets remained unaffected.

news.title: Bitget confirms $387.5 million security breach affecting exchange hot wallets
news.summary: Bitget said private keys were not compromised and that losses from the incident will be covered by its User Protection Fund.

news.title: Fed proposes reserve limits, capital standards for stablecoin issuers under GENIUS Act
news.summary: The Federal Reserve proposed new measures for stablecoin issuers, including reserve-asset limits and standardized capital requirements.

news.title: Someone was trying to sell Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death
news.summary: The company has vehemently denied that it was shopping for buyers. Allman’s estate declined to comment.

news.title: Bullish, Alpaca, Apex Fintech and DriveWealth form coalition to push issuer-backed tokenized stocks
news.summary: The group aims to link onchain shares to official shareholder records following the U.S. SEC's innovation exemption for tokenized stock trading.

news.title: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
news.summary: The U.S derivatives regulator is grinding away at further guidance that welcomes tokenization and blockchain recordkeeping as regular industry elements.

news.title: The stock token debate, and the gap nobody can close alone
news.summary: The argument over Robinhood’s AMC token has been about which tokenization model is legitimate, and the SEC has drawn a line. The question to ask now is what has to be true for any of it to be a market, argues Bullish’s Tram Doman.

news.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI keeps board after shareholder protest, loses equity plan vote
news.summary: SkyAI’s board survived a shareholder protest, but its proposed equity pay plan fell by a wide margin.

news.title: Bitcoin just topped a key long-term moving average. Here's what it might mean
news.summary: Bitcoin’s return above its one-year average excited chart watchers. AltcoinPro Research says the more important signal is whether it can stay above its 200-day average.

news.title: ARK Invest brings $1.3 billion venture fund onchain through Securitize
news.summary: ARK Invest is bringing its $1.3B ARK Venture Fund (ARKVX), which holds OpenAI, Anthropic and Stripe, onchain via Securitize on Ethereum.

news.title: JPMorgan says bitcoin crossing $85,000 production cost could ease miner selling pressure
news.summary: JPMorgan analysts said bitcoin's move above its estimated $85,000 production cost could ease miner selling if sustained.

news.title: New York moves to block Polymarket from the state, alleging it’s running an illegal gambling operation
news.summary: New York has sued Polymarket, accusing it of operating an illegal gambling operation and asking a court to block it from operating.

news.title: Ondo launches onchain portfolio tokens based on BlackRock-developed strategies
news.summary: Ondo has launched three onchain portfolio tokens based on model portfolio strategies developed by BlackRock.

news.title: Solana Foundation taps Binance, Polygon vets to drive institutional adoption and payments
news.summary: Solana Foundation appointed Rachel Conlan as chief strategy officer and former Polygon Labs exec Jamal Raees as GM of payments.

news.title: HIFI raises $37 million Series A to expand tokenized capital markets infrastructure
news.summary: HIFI raised $37 million in Series A funding led by Left Lane Capital to scale tokenized settlement infrastructure.

news.title: IBM connects Digital Asset Haven to Swift blockchain ledger for tokenized deposit transactions
news.summary: IBM Digital Asset Haven clients can now connect to Swift's shared ledger and instruct tokenized deposit transactions.

news.title: Brooklyn man gets up to 12 years over $16 million Coinbase social engineering scheme
news.summary: A court sentenced 23-year-old Ronald Spektor to four to 12 years in prison for a $15.9 million Coinbase phishing scheme.

news.title: Hut 8 wins bidding for Poolin’s Texas data centers with $140 million offer
news.summary: The proposed acquisition would add two Texas sites to Hut 8’s expanding AI infrastructure portfolio.
